note: Corrections from the catalan-philologist audit. Each one was a word, gloss or example sentence that taught a learner something false. Applied by scripts/patch-ca-lexicon.ts alongside the other authored sources. 'why' cites what makes the old version wrong, so a later reader can check the judgement rather than trust it.

delete.why: glossed 'floor'; sorra is sand. The floor is 'el terra', which already has an entry
not a DIEC2 form; reads as a blend of làmpada with the castellanisme llàmpara
glossed 'hike' with the invented idiom 'anar de sender'; sender is a path
third entry glossed 'floor', after sorra and terra; the everyday word is terra

patch.exampleTarget: Em fa mal el muscle dret.
patch.exampleEn: My right shoulder hurts.
patch.why: DIEC2: muscle is the top of the shoulder where the arm joins. It was glossed 'muscle', so the example read 'I have an injured shoulder' under an English gloss about muscles.

patch.glossEn: floor, ground (el terra); earth, soil (la terra)
patch.exampleEn: The floor is cold.
patch.why: el terra is the floor of a room, la terra is soil - a gender trap Spanish (el suelo / la tierra) gives no warning about. The example said 'the soil is cold'.

patch.exampleEn: My elbow is swollen.
patch.why: spelling only

patch.exampleEn: The washing machine is very handy.
patch.why: was glossed 'dishwasher'; that is rentaplats

patch.exampleEn: I put my stockings on.
patch.why: was glossed 'sock'; DIEC2 separates mitja from mitjó by how far up the leg it goes

patch.exampleTarget: He oblidat el paraigua a casa.
patch.exampleEn: I've left my umbrella at home.
patch.why: the example wrote 'paràguas', Spanish paraguas with a Catalan-looking accent bolted on

patch.exampleTarget: He de reparar el llum de la cuina.
patch.exampleEn: I have to fix the kitchen light.
patch.why: the example wrote 'llàmpada', which is not a word

patch.exampleEn: My great-grandmother was very wise.
patch.why: 'savia' without the accent is not a word; the masculine savi was already spelt correctly

patch.exampleEn: I fight for equality.
patch.why: wrote l'igualtat; la does not elide before an unstressed i-, which is what gl-02 teaches

patch.exampleEn: I sit on the chair.
patch.why: 'Em seiem' is the 1st person plural of a non-pronominal verb; seure has no em

patch.exampleEn: I sit down in the armchair.
patch.why: same; asseure's is the pronominal verb

patch.glossEn: one (counting; before a noun it is 'un')
patch.exampleTarget: El número guanyador és el vint-i-u.
patch.exampleEn: The winning number is twenty-one.
patch.why: 'Tinc u gos' - u is the arithmetic cardinal, never a determiner

patch.exampleTarget: Porto la ràdio a la cuina.
patch.exampleEn: I carry the radio into the kitchen.
patch.why: 'Llevo la ràdio' is the Spanish llevar; Catalan llevar means to remove or to get up

patch.exampleEn: There is internet at the hotel.
patch.why: 'N'hi ha d'internet' - en cannot co-occur with the noun it stands for

patch.exampleTarget: He desat la imatge al telèfon.
patch.exampleEn: I saved the image on my phone.
patch.why: the example wrote 'telefon' without its accent

patch.exampleTarget: El sofà és darrere la taula.
patch.exampleEn: The sofa is behind the table.
patch.why: as preposition and adverb the form is darrere; darrera is only the feminine adjective 'last' (Optimot)

patch.exampleEn: I put red pepper in the salad.
patch.why: was glossed 'pepper' in a spice list; the spice is pebre, pebrot is the bell pepper

patch.exampleEn: The public health service is good.
patch.why: was glossed 'sanitation', which is sanejament

patch.exampleEn: I claimed the money back.
patch.why: was glossed 'to complain', which is queixar-se

patch.exampleEn: I feel a pain in my back.
patch.why: 'Tinc dolor de cap' is the Spanish dolor de cabeza; Catalan says mal de cap

patch.exampleEn: I go to the doctor every year.
patch.why: 'Vinc al metge' means 'I come to the doctor' - the opposite of its own gloss

patch.exampleTarget: La meva àvia va enviudar molt jove.
patch.exampleEn: My grandmother was widowed very young.
patch.why: DIEC2 lists it as intransitive, not pronominal

patch.exampleEn: Serve me a cup of coffee.
patch.why: the Catalan was 3rd person indicative against an English imperative, teaching the indicative as an imperative

patch.exampleTarget: Explica'm la idea, si us plau.
patch.exampleEn: Explain the idea to me, please.
patch.why: same: 'M'explica la idea' is 'he explains the idea to me'

patch.exampleTarget: A l'hivern porto un abric gros.
patch.exampleEn: In winter I wear a thick coat.
patch.why: 'Du un abric gros' glossed as 'you wear'; du is 3rd person

patch.exampleEn: I did it like this.
patch.why: 'Així que ho vaig veure' glossed 'Thus I saw it'; així que means 'as soon as' or 'so'

patch.exampleEn: My home is small.
patch.why: was glossed 'hearth'

patch.exampleEn: I buy books at the bookshop.
patch.why: was glossed only 'bookshelf'
